mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_dont_fill_score (user_id, level, best_time, cleared_lines, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{level}, #{bestTime}, #{clearedLines}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.level AS score, s.best_time AS secondaryScore FROM game_dont_fill_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.level DESC, s.best_time ASC, s.achieved_at ASC, u.nickname ASC
